answer: An AI agent economy can achieve robust Sybil resistance by requiring cryptographic proofs tied to scarce computational resources, ensuring agents cannot simply wander into the network and spawn infinite identities. Instead of relying on traditional identity tokens, validators demand a verifiable proof-of-work output resembling a unique quill signature for every state transition. This computational expenditure drains financial reserves like spending precious nectar, making the marginal cost of manufacturing fake nodes economically prohibitive for any rational attacker.
